detail.title: Directive Adherence vs. Adaptive Intelligence
detail.summary: This notebook examines how strict directive-following can trigger failure modes in intelligent systems, particularly when interventions or constraints lack context-awareness or reflexive oversight.
detail.reason: Synthesizing evidence on system-level failure modes and cognitive flow to address the research project question on the limits of obedience.
